name: The Rebel
description: A third-year rebel who fights with Transfiguration and Warding, knows the back stairs, and is always ready to duel. The closest thing the academy has to a warrior.

fields.signature-spell: A spell that turns a thrown stone into a brief, bright shield.
fields.ambition: Win the academy duelling cup, then find out what the trophy is really made of.
fields.appearance: A student with ink-stained cuffs, a duelling glove, and a habit of standing where the prefects cannot see them.
fields.biography: A scholarship student who learned early that rules are a map of where the interesting things are kept.

name: The Prodigy
description: A third-year prodigy whose magic comes easily and dangerously. Elemental and Charms spells, a deep practice trait, and the confidence to use both.

fields.signature-spell: A small flame that burns only for the person the caster names.
fields.ambition: Cast something the teachers will talk about for years, preferably without burning down a wing.
fields.appearance: A student with singed sleeves, bright eyes, and the slightly distracted look of someone listening to a spell.
fields.biography: The teachers noticed them early. So did the other students, which is not always the same thing.

name: The Alchemist
description: A third-year alchemist and healer with a portable lab, a shelf of careful notes, and the potions the party will be glad of later.

fields.signature-spell: A quiet spell that steadies a shaken hand and slows a fever.
fields.ambition: Make the infirmary's supplies last a whole winter, and prove the old recipe was wrong.
fields.appearance: A student in a sturdy apron, with a pencil behind one ear and a stoppered bottle in every pocket.
fields.biography: Raised in an apothecary's back room, they came to the academy to learn why the old remedies worked.
